Development solver: complete QStarS v1 validation gates are not satisfied.
Fixed excision boundary; accretion luminosity laws do not imply replication of a full published boundary model.
Newtonian, fixed composition; no nuclear evolution, rotation, magnetic fields, or GR.
Inflow and outflow are separate, co-moving boundary source cells; multidimensional stream geometry is unresolved.
Radial inertia is retained; no nonlinear pulsation or shock validation has been established.
Fully ionized ideal gas plus radiation EOS; recombination and degeneracy excluded.
Grey boundary is a constant-opacity extrapolation; reported effective temperature is a flux diagnostic, not a validated cool photosphere.
Convection uses the optically thick lossless-blob approximation; radiative losses of blobs and time-dependent convection are omitted.
